title: Understanding Non-Response Bias
text: Non-response bias occurs when the individuals who do not respond to a survey differ in significant ways from those who do respond. Consider whether offering extra credit might influence the type of students who choose to participate.

title: Incentives and Survey Participation
text: Think about how offering extra credit might affect the willingness of students to participate in the survey. Does this incentive ensure that all types of students are equally likely to respond?

title: Evaluating the Sampling Process
text: Consider the characteristics of the students who might be more inclined to take the survey due to the extra credit incentive. Are these characteristics representative of the entire student population?

title: Impact of Extra Credit on Survey Results
text: Does offering extra credit for survey participation eliminate the possibility of bias in the survey results? Think about whether all students have an equal chance of participating.
